"""Read-only integrity/claim verification for M5 synthetic mechanism receipts."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,stat,subprocess
ROOT=Path('/Users/mukeshreddypochamreddy/Desktop/project x')
path=ROOT/'docs/evidence/M5/attestation-preflight-receipts.json'
d=json.loads(path.read_text())
checks=[]
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def check(name,value):
    checks.append({'name':name,'passed':bool(value)})
check('receipt_schema',d['schema']=='M5-native-attestation-preflight-receipts-v1')
check('no_harness_failure','harness_failure' not in d)
check('no_claimed_human_approval',d['human_approval_created'] is False)
check('no_production_enrollment',d['production_signer_enrollment_performed'] is False)
check('command_count',len(d['commands'])==43)
check('command_ids_unique',len({r['id'] for r in d['commands']})==43)
check('clean_child_environment',set(d['environment_for_all_children'])=={'PATH','LANG','LC_ALL','TZ'})
for r in d['commands']:
    for stream in ['stdin','stdout','stderr']:
        check(r['id']+'_'+stream+'_hash',sha(r[stream+'_utf8'].encode())==r[stream+'_sha256'])
    check(r['id']+'_finished',not r['timed_out'] and type(r['exit_status']) is int)
    check(r['id']+'_exit',r['exit_status']==(255 if r['id'].startswith('reject_') else 0))
    if '/usr/bin/ssh-keygen'==r['argv'][0]:
        check(r['id']+'_explicit_key_or_trust_path','-f' in r['argv'] or r['id']=='check_novalidate_unallowed_key')
check('sixteen_negative_cases',sum(r['id'].startswith('reject_') for r in d['commands'])==16)
by_id={r['id']:r for r in d['commands']}
a,b=by_id['verify_original'],by_id['verify_exact_replay']
check('replay_exact_argv',a['argv']==b['argv'])
check('replay_exact_message',a['stdin_sha256']==b['stdin_sha256'])
check('replay_exact_result',a['exit_status']==b['exit_status']==0 and a['stdout_utf8']==b['stdout_utf8'])
payload=json.loads(a['stdin_utf8'])
check('synthetic_payload_not_human',payload['diagnostic_only'] is True and payload['actor_type']=='model_diagnostic' and payload['decision']=='NO_TASK_APPROVAL')
for item in d['created_public_inputs']:
    raw=item['utf8'].encode()
    check(item['path']+'_captured_hash',sha(raw)==item['sha256'] and len(raw)==item['bytes'])
    check(item['path']+'_file_hash',sha((ROOT/item['path']).read_bytes())==item['sha256'])
for item in d['primary_sources']:
    check(item['local_path']+'_body_hash',sha((ROOT/item['local_path']).read_bytes())==item['body_sha256'])
    check(item['local_path']+'_header_hash',sha(item['http_headers_utf8'].encode())==item['http_headers_sha256'])
    check(item['local_path']+'_http_200',by_id[item['command_id']]['stdout_utf8'].startswith('200\n'))
check('local_manual_matches_upstream',sha(Path('/usr/share/man/man1/ssh-keygen.1').read_bytes())==next(x['body_sha256'] for x in d['primary_sources'] if x['local_path'].endswith('upstream-ssh-keygen.1')))
check('binary_hash',sha(Path('/usr/bin/ssh-keygen').read_bytes())=='6949a5fb9e80c47f2126e523db7b232b37794fb33da9f70b2dd8b8742802248e')
for item in d['read_file_bindings']:
    if item['path'] in ['docs/progress.md','docs/interfaces.md']:continue
    p=Path(item['path']) if item['path'].startswith('/') else ROOT/item['path']
    check(item['path']+'_stable_input_hash',sha(p.read_bytes())==item['sha256'])
h=d['diagnostic_harness']
check('harness_captured_hash',sha(h['source_utf8'].encode())==h['sha256'])
check('harness_file_hash',sha((ROOT/h['path']).read_bytes())==h['sha256'])
for item in d['private_key_metadata_only']:
    key=ROOT/item['path']
    check(item['path']+'_mode',stat.S_IMODE(key.stat().st_mode)==0o600)
    proc=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/git','check-ignore',str(key)],cwd=ROOT,env=d['environment_for_all_children'],capture_output=True,check=False)
    check(item['path']+'_ignored',proc.returncode==0)
    check(item['path']+'_not_exported',item['private_bytes_recorded'] is False)
check('no_private_key_block_in_committed_receipt',b'-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----' not in path.read_bytes())
report=ROOT/'docs/evidence/M5/attestation-preflight.md'
text=report.read_text()
check('report_binds_receipt',sha(path.read_bytes()) in text)
check('report_records_replay_acceptance','No native duplicate-consumption or replay rejection' in text)
check('report_no_implemented_replay_claim','No application replay substitute was implemented or simulated.' in text)
check('report_separates_enrollment','outside model write authority' in text)
for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
    if link.startswith('https://'):continue
    check('local_link_'+link,(report.parent/link).resolve().exists())
summary={
    'scope':'raw_receipt_integrity_and_report_claim_checks_only',
    'check_count':len(checks), 'passed':sum(c['passed'] for c in checks),
    'failed':[c for c in checks if not c['passed']], 'checks':checks,
    'receipt_sha256':sha(path.read_bytes()), 'report_sha256':sha(report.read_bytes()),
}
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if not summary['failed'] else 1)
